description: This file declares classes related to AWC (possibly 'Application Window Controller') state change listening and notification within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace. It defines interfaces and classes for handling state change events, managing listeners, and implementing a client listener for window and application state changes.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about application state changes.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages a list of AWCStateChangeListeners and notifies them of state changes.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Implements the AWCClient::Listener interface to receive window and state change notifications and forwards them to the notifier.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from the notifier.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change.

methods.name: AWCListener(AWCStateChangeNotifier * notifier)
methods.description: Constructor for AWCListener, takes a notifier to forward events.

methods.name: notifyWindowChange
methods.description: Handles window change notifications from AWCClient.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles application state change notifications from AWCClient.
